title: Crypto Bug in CRT
description: A surreal beetle-like creature with a glowing orange carapace and human-like hands sits inside a cracked vintage CRT computer monitor. It smokes a pipe while pink liquid drips from a heart-shaped object onto a piece of paper, as golden crypto coins and colorful pixel dust cascade down a mound of dirt and broken monitor fragments.
prompt: A surreal dark scene featuring a large iridescent beetle creature with glowing orange shell and human hands emerging from inside a cracked old CRT computer monitor. The bug is smoking a pipe with smoke rising, pink liquid drips from a bright pink heart onto a piece of paper below. Golden crypto coins and multicolored pixel particles flow down a mound of dirt and broken monitor pieces against a black background with floating orbs and arcane symbols.
